name: auctionclear
tagline: Call-auction uncrossing with each venue's tie-break rules, checked against brute force over every price
trendOrigin: Trend 5 (A-share short-term review, where the opening call auction drives the day) and Trend 1. The opening and closing auctions decide the prices those dashboards show, yet almost nobody implements the uncross correctly. Most engines get maximum volume right and the tie-breaks wrong.
